name: 92126 · San Diego, CA
findings: ZIP 92126 (San Diego) has 167 nonprofit organizations. 69 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92126 (San Diego) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
